index_case.markdown:
# Published emoji packs

2 packs, 2 emoji. Captured 2026-10-07 00:00:00 UTC live from Telegram.

Each pack has three files named after the set: `.md` to read, `.json` to parse, and `.html` to LOOK at -- one self-contained page with every thumbnail inline (animation included) and the same roster repeated in a `<script type="application/json">` block. `index.json` also carries three flat lookups: `by_current_id` (id -> where it lives now), `by_source_id` (the id an emoji had in its original pack -> ours) and `by_previous_id` (an id of OURS that a replace retired -> the id that took its place), so a stale reference resolves either way.

| Pack | Set | Emoji | Link |
|------|-----|------:|------|
| coins 1 | `coins_by_YourEmojiBot` | 1 | https://t.me/addemoji/coins_by_YourEmojiBot |
| general 1 | `fixture_by_YourEmojiBot` | 1 | https://t.me/addemoji/fixture_by_YourEmojiBot |
